theorems.name: Submission.p10_17ae7b7d_pp_translation_charts
theorems.statement: ∀ (p a : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → 1 ≤ a → let R := ZMod (p ^ a); let Q := (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) ⧸ CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 (p ^ a); ∃ e : Q ≃ (R ⊕ {z : R // p ∣ z.val}), (∀ t : R, e (ModularGroup.T⁻¹ • e.symm (Sum.inl t)) = Sum.inl (t + 1)) ∧ (∀ z : {z : R // p ∣ z.val}, ∃ w : {z : R // p ∣ z.val}, e (ModularGroup.T⁻¹ • e.symm (Sum.inr z)) = Sum.inr w ∧ w.1 = z.1 * (1 + z.1)⁻¹)
theorems.natural_summary: Uses accepted row-normalization and inverse-coset lemmas to construct the equivalence and compute the translation action.
